name: Ocinaplon
summary: Ocinaplon is an anxiolytic drug in the pyrazolopyrimidine family of drugs. Other pyrazolopyrimidine drugs include zaleplon and indiplon.

pharmacology.text: The mechanism of action by which ocinaplon produces its anxiolytic effects is by modulating GABAA receptors, although ocinaplon is more subtype-selective than most benzodiazepines.

uses.text: A 2019 review found tentative evidence of benefit in anxiety.

sideEffects.en: Its trials were stopped after signs of liver injury appeared in some participants. Drugs acting at the benzodiazepine site can also cause drowsiness and poor coordination.
sideEffects.zh: 在部分受試者出現肝損傷徵象後，它的試驗被中止。作用於苯二氮平位點的藥物也可能造成嗜睡與協調變差。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在部分受试者出现肝损伤征象后，它的试验被中止。作用于苯二氮平位点的药物也可能造成嗜睡与协调制差。

fact.en: It belongs to the same pyrazolopyrimidine family as the sleeping tablet zaleplon, but it was aimed at anxiety rather than sleep.
fact.zh: 它與安眠藥扎來普隆同屬吡唑嘧啶類，但研發目標是焦慮而非睡眠。
fact.zhHans: 它与安眠药扎来普隆同属吡唑嘧啶类，但研发目标是焦虑而非睡眠。
